data.body: A section template is a recipe for a section: canonical structure plus neutral starter copy, stamped standalone or straight into a page.

Body fields

  • tracking
  • name (required)
  • description
  • whenToUse
  • scope
  • blueprint (required)

Patch operations

  • set_section_template_meta
  • replace_blueprint
  • update_blueprint_data
  • set_tracking

This reference is generated from the live object_contract. If it disagrees with the contract, the manual is wrong and the drift guard fails the build of it.

Worked example

stpl_dtc_launch_matrix is a reusable comparison-table recipe. A stamp deep-copies its blueprint with a fresh section id; later recipe edits affect only future stamps.

Lifecycle note

Reuse inventory before creating a new recipe, and document description, when-to-use, and scope.
